KOREAN RESTAURANT FIELD NOTES

Learn the menu before your trip.

Read the words you will meet, work through a sample order, then try it yourself. Every guide stands on its own; you do not need to play the game to use it.

Not sure where to start?

First read the six dish names, then dine-in or takeaway. Use the basket checklist before your first practice confirmation.
